The BoM table and mapped Landsborough River place Tragowel upstream of Muttaburra.
The mapped Muttaburra river site is above Camoola Park; no relative order to the nearby Muttaburra automatic instrument is asserted.
The mapped Muttaburra automatic site is on the upper Thomson system above Camoola Park.

The mapped Torrens Creek Township gauge drains into the upper Thomson system above Camoola Park. The BoM map and 2026 specification place it in Cooper basin, correcting the catalogue basin label. Intermediate gauges are omitted.
The mapped Paroo channel reaches Caiwarro before Hungerford; this supplies the receiving warning area with a connection even when the Eulo gauge is outside its selected footprint.
The mapped Milroy monitoring reach on the Bulloo River is above Quilpie. No relative order between the manual and telemetry Milroy instruments is asserted.
The mapped Milroy monitoring reach on the Bulloo River is above Quilpie. No relative order between the manual and telemetry Milroy instruments is asserted.
The mapped Woodspring site on Canning Creek is above the Macintyre Brook receiving reach at Booba Sands. Its relative order to the older Woodspring manual site is not asserted.

Reviewed public station location on the mapped Blackwater Creek above Adavale, corroborated by its position before Adavale in the BoM survey listing. No gauge-zero elevation is used as direction evidence.
Reviewed location of the Moga/Mooga Creek monitor on the mapped tributary above the Roma Bungil Creek gauges. No order relative to the Tabers gauge above the confluence is asserted.
Reviewed BoM station location on the mapped Warrill Creek reach above Harrisville. No order relative to the Toohills Crossing instruments is asserted.
Cunnamulla Bridge AMTD 130.5 km is above Cunnamulla Weir AMTD 124.5 km. The 2024 provider location corroborates AWRC 423202C despite the older directory coordinate discrepancy.
The mapped Warrego channel continues below Cunnamulla Weir to Rocky.

equivalentSites.note: Both Connolly Dam instruments have AMTD 21.7 km and catalogue locations 39 m apart; only their external ordering is shared.
The 2026 specification lists both Toohills Crossing instruments together on page 63; their catalogue locations coincide.
The 2026 specification groups these Berrys Lagoon instruments on page 63; their locations are 140 m apart on the same river reach.
Both source names identify Maroon Dam headwater instruments and their catalogue locations coincide.
Both Moogerah headwater gauges have AMTD 15.3 km and are 39 m apart. Seqwater identifies Reynolds Creek, correcting the older directory label for 540474.

Provider AWRC 143312A identifies the downstream Kilcoy Weir site at the published provider location, 26 m from the Alert location. The two network positions differ by only 12 m; no relative order between the instruments is asserted.
